clips.title: The story
paras: Gurda Ragescar fell at a Horde camp southwest of Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. She and Feran Strongwind died defending it against dangers in the shadowed forest.

Gurda Ragescar and her guards fell at a small Horde camp southwest of Splintertree Post. The outpost stood beneath Ashenvale's dense canopy, deep in territory contested by night elven defenders and wild beasts. Gurda and Feran Strongwind were killed when the camp was overrun. Only remnants of their last stand remain for passing allies to find.

Travelers near the trail may find the scene of Gurda's defeat. The camp's possessions and unfinished work point to Horde efforts across the woods, including missing documents and orders disrupted by the ambush.
